newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen adding reserves via multi-day system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen adding reserves via multi-day system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve on Monday was expected to add reserves into the banking system through a round of system repurchase agreements.
Analysts said the operation would likely be multi-day, with some expecting up to 10-day system RPs.

The Fed faces about a $6.5 billion average daily add need for the first week of the maintenance period, Fed watchers said. And, by staying out of the open market on Friday, a large operation this session is highly probable.
Fed funds were trading at 5-1/2 percent, at the Fed's current official target level.
Analysts also noted that there was a very good chance the Fed could add permanent reserves to the banking system this week by buying coupons or, more likely, bills.
